description:
About Scowtt

 Scowtt helps advertisers improve campaign performance using AI and first-party customer data, connecting CRM systems with platforms including Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft Ads, and LinkedIn.

 The Opportunity

 We’re seeking a hands-on contractor to partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering on customer technical onboarding, implementation audits, and ongoing troubleshooting. You’ll independently diagnose issues, implement fixes where appropriate, and give customers clear, prescriptive guidance.

 What You’ll Do

 
 Audit website tracking across Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and related tools; verify click identifiers (GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, etc.) are captured and passed through lead forms.

 Trace leads and conversion data from websites into Salesforce or HubSpot; troubleshoot JavaScript, API calls, webhooks, field mappings, and missing or delayed data.

 Help customers configure Scowtt integrations, account permissions, authentication, and SSO; resolve technical issues during onboarding and after launch.

 Work directly with customer teams to implement fixes or provide actionable instructions; escalate product defects with clear diagnostic evidence.

 Use Scowtt’s internal auditing and diagnostic tools, plus approved AI-assisted engineering tools, to speed investigation and resolution while independently validating results.

 Document repeatable solutions and suggest lightweight automation that makes onboarding and support more scalable.

 
 AI-Powered Tools & Engineering Enablement

 Scowtt equips customer-facing engineers with approved AI-assisted development tools, internal auditing utilities, and implementation playbooks. We expect you to combine those resources with sound engineering judgment to deliver accurate, timely solutions.

 
 Use AI coding and troubleshooting assistants to investigate JavaScript, API, and integration issues, prepare diagnostic scripts, and draft clear customer implementation steps.

 Use Scowtt’s internal website attribution auditor and other diagnostic tools to inspect tracking tags, form submissions, click-identifier capture, and CRM data flow.

 Independently verify AI-generated suggestions and tool findings against browser traces, API responses, and actual customer configurations; protect customer information and follow approved access practices.

 Turn recurring investigations into reusable checklists, automation, scripts, or clear self-service guidance, in partnership with Engineering.

 
 Working Style & Customer Impact

 This is a hands-on execution role, not a general help-desk position. You will own technical investigations end to end, collaborate directly with customer developers and marketers, communicate progress clearly, and know when to escalate product defects to Scowtt Engineering. Success means helping customers reach a reliable production setup quickly while reducing repeated troubleshooting effort.

 What You Bring

 
 3+ years in web development, technical integrations, implementation, or solutions engineering, with strong JavaScript, HTML, browser DevTools, and debugging skills.

 Practical experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, and third-party SaaS integrations.

 Familiarity with Google/Meta tracking and Salesforce or HubSpot data models and integrations.

 Strong customer communication, independent problem-solving, and ownership through resolution.

 
 Nice to Have

 GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Conversions API, offline/enhanced conversions, LinkedIn or Microsoft Ads, SAML/OIDC, Python, SQL, and experience with AI coding assistants.

 Engagement

 Independent contractor; remote; part-time engagement with US business-hour overlap. Initial scope and duration to be agreed. Success means faster customer onboarding, reliable tracking and CRM data flows, and fewer escalations to core Engineering.
